questions.topic: eGurukul · Lower Limb (Other Fracture Till Toes)
questions.stem: A 30-year-old man who sustained a tibial fracture with a peroneal nerve palsy 2 years ago now has foot drop and weak eversion of the foot. He reports success with stretching exercises, but he catches his toes when his foot tires. Examination reveals that the foot is plantigrade and supple. What is the most appropriate next step in management?

options.label: A
options.text: Posterior tibial tendon transfer to the cuboid

options.label: B
options.text: Anterior tibial tendon transfer to the cuboid
